name: Stephanas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: I beseech you, brethren, ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves. They have what? Addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation
